title: fix(desktop): strip quoted/colon-delimited generated-image echoes
claim: stripGeneratedImageEchoes' bare-path pass only matches a known generated-image path bounded by whitespace/brackets/sentence punctuation, so a path the model restates inside quotes, backticks or before a colon survives in the prose despite the doc comment saying bare occurrences are removed.

evidence.source: main apps/desktop/src/lib/generated-images.ts:88: `(^|[\s([{])<?src>?(?=$|[\s)\]},.!?])` - quotes, backticks, colon, semicolon are not boundaries. Doc comment (:96-101) says bare occurrences are removed.
evidence.red: Probe on main: expect(strip('Saved to "/tmp/cat.png" just now.')).not.toContain('/tmp/cat.png') -> AssertionError: expected 'Saved to "/tmp/cat.png" just now.' not to contain '/tmp/cat.png'. Gap is real.
evidence.green: Fork regex applied to main: fork's own claims pass (probe + existing generated-images.test.ts, 11/11).
evidence.negative_control: Not run on a rebuilt fix (not rebuilt); RED on main == fork line reverted.
probe_main: "Saved to \"/tmp/cat.png\" just now." => "Saved to \"/tmp/cat.png\" just now."
probe_fork: "Saved to \"/tmp/cat.png\" just now." => "Saved to \"\" just now."
evidence.why_rework: Fork output leaves empty-delimiter debris: 'Saved to `/tmp/cat.png`.' -> 'Saved to ``.' (stray literal backticks replacing a readable code-span path - the most common model phrasing), '""', "''", 'Generated : done'. Its symmetric boundary also keeps '(' / ')' as boundaries, so '[the file](/tmp/cat.png)' -> '[the file]()' persists - exactly what open #81462 removes.

upstream_overlap: #81462 OPEN (DavidMetcalfe, external, head 6d82e4a50a, updated 2026-09-30; refs #80621): rewrites stripGeneratedImageEchoes including this exact bare-path regex, deliberately dropping '(' / ')' from the boundary classes to stop markdown link destinations being corrupted. It does NOT add quotes/colon (claim not fixed there), but any change to this line must be built on/after it. A symmetric-boundary PR now would collide with and partly undo #81462.
#105069 OPEN (nftpoetrist) touches stream-completion trimming after echo extraction (use-message-stream), not this regex.
#70891 OPEN touches message-parts.tsx, not this file.
notes: Fork test hunks no longer apply to main (test file trimmed by 81235c9add). Rework direction: strip a matching wrapper pair (quotes/backticks) together with the path, keep parens out of the boundary set per #81462, and rebuild only after #81462 lands - or offer the quote/backtick/colon cases to #81462 as review input. Low user impact (cosmetic: path text stays in prose; image still renders in the tool slot). NOT_TESTED: desktop typecheck/lint, rendered markdown in the app.
